name: Harmony 350, does AVR/Game turn Watch TV off
description: On lab/work/350-every-key/every-key.bin. The previous run showed TV/Media does not switch Watch TV off. AVR/Game's press switches a light on output pin RB0, on the same port as the keypad's column wires, and no later press sets that pin back, while TV/Media's light is on another port. This run checks whether AVR/Game is the trigger, with Menu, on Watch TV's column, as the control, and asks what the two lights do.

steps.instruction: Take the batteries out of the Harmony 350 and put them back, unplugged from USB. Do not press any device key. Point it at the receiver
Press Watch TV once. It should send Info
Press AVR/Game (bottom left of the four device keys) once and briefly, and watch its light for a few seconds: note whether it blinks, and whether it stays lit afterwards. Nothing should be heard
Press Volume Up once, to show the receiver is selected
Press TV/Media once and briefly, and again note what the lights under TV/Media and AVR/Game do
Press Watch TV once. Predicted: silent, since AVR/Game's light pin is still where its press left it
Press Menu once, a key on the same column wire as Watch TV, as a control
Press Volume Up once, to show the remote is in the TV's mode
